surfaces.summary: Versioned deterministic Canonical IR contract for the implemented compiler subset.
surfaces.supportStatement: Canonical IR is implemented at irVersion 0.3.0 with a closed schema and deterministic serialization for the implemented compiler subset.

surfaces.summary: Cloud declarations and selected validation semantics exist without a complete provider runtime.
surfaces.supportStatement: Cloud profile support is partial: selected declarations and semantics are compiler-visible, but complete provider adapters and runtime coverage are not implemented.

surfaces.summary: Compiler Core has substantial implemented coverage but M10 has not yet certified every declaration and semantic rule across every layer.
surfaces.supportStatement: Core support is partial at conformance level: parser, compiler-owned resolution and validation, diagnostics, and Canonical IR exist for the documented subset, while M10 layer-completeness certification remains open.

surfaces.summary: Selected distributed ownership, delivery, outbox, and fixture semantics are implemented without a general distributed runtime.
surfaces.supportStatement: Distributed profile support is partial: selected compiler and fixture semantics are implemented, but a general multi-service runtime remains future work.

surfaces.summary: Media syntax and selected compiler/fixture semantics exist without production media processing runtime support.
surfaces.supportStatement: Media profile support is partial: selected syntax and compiler/fixture evidence exist, but upload, transcoding, delivery, and provider runtime support are not complete.

surfaces.summary: Selected offline/sync semantics are compiler- and fixture-covered without the complete multi-writer runtime.
surfaces.supportStatement: Offline profile support is partial: selected sync/conflict semantics are represented in compiler fixtures, but the complete offline multi-writer runtime is not implemented.

surfaces.summary: Realtime remains a specified profile without a production channel runtime claim.
surfaces.supportStatement: Realtime is currently a specified profile; no production channel runtime support is claimed.

surfaces.summary: Web remains a broad specified profile without complete compiler/generator/runtime conformance evidence.
surfaces.supportStatement: Web is currently a specified profile; complete compiler, generator, and runtime conformance is not claimed.

surfaces.summary: M9-08 deterministic scoped prerelease bundle with exact-tag-only GitHub prerelease publication after verification.
surfaces.supportStatement: The reproducible scoped prerelease bundle is implemented with manifest, SHA-256 checksums, tracked contracts, scoped notes, and public GitHub prerelease publication gated to the verified exact configured tag.

surfaces.summary: Native main branch protection remains an open M9 requirement.
surfaces.supportStatement: Native main branch protection remains blocked/open and must not be described as enforced.

surfaces.summary: Bounded TypeScript/Fastify/PostgreSQL M4 vertical slice with generated ownership and Petstore E2E evidence.
surfaces.supportStatement: The bounded M4 TypeScript/Fastify/PostgreSQL Petstore vertical slice is implemented and tested; it is not a general runtime for every profile.

surfaces.summary: Installable compiler-owned CLI with current registered command surface and versioned JSON contracts.
surfaces.supportStatement: The compiler-owned aidl CLI is implemented and installable for Python 3.12 with its registered command surface and versioned JSON output contracts.

surfaces.summary: Compiler-backed IntelliJ semantics are implemented for documented operations without full-profile editor conformance.
surfaces.supportStatement: IntelliJ support is partial at conformance level: documented compiler-backed diagnostics, fixes, navigation, rename, completion, and documentation paths exist, but full-profile editor conformance is not claimed.

surfaces.summary: Saved-file stdio LSP proof of concept only.
surfaces.supportStatement: The LSP surface is experimental: only the saved-file stdio proof of concept is claimed, not production unsaved-buffer support.
